snippet.title: A.I.L.A - Release Window Trailer | Galaxies Autumn 2025 Showcase
snippet.description: A.I.L.A is a first-person horror experience set in a near-future world obsessed with immersive technology. As the lone tester of a groundbreaking artificial intelligence, you’ll face terrifying simulations that twist reality itself and your own mind. Witness a taste of the horror in this release window announcement trailer that premiered at Galaxies Autumn 2025.
